استصرخوا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْرَخُوا (istaṣraḵū) /is.tasˤ.ra.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# اُسْتُصْرِخُوا (ustuṣriḵū) /us.tusˤ.ri.xuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# اِسْتَصْرِخُوا (istaṣriḵū) /is.tasˤ.ri.xuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
